## Workload

During 2019 Q2, Chloe Mensah graded 903 sets over 435 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 2.1 per hour. The workload was completed within the rostered period and provides the basis for the review of both output and grading consistency.

## Quality

A sample of 84 sets was read again to assess grading consistency. The recorded agreement was 73.8 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent decisions in similar work.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
